title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Thank the parents
hook: When did you last thank your team's parents?
intro: Parents drive, wash uniforms, and bring snacks.
Most of it happens without a word.
statement: A little thanks keeps volunteers coming back.
q1: Do you thank parents during the season —
q2: or save it for the end-of-season party?
q3: Which parent does the most behind the scenes?
t1: Both can work. But help keeps coming
t2: when people feel noticed along the way.
cta: Coaches — how do you thank parents?
ctaLines: A note. A shout-out in the huddle. A team card.
ctaPrompt: Share your thank-you habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When did you last thank your team's parents?
Parents drive, wash uniforms, and bring snacks. Most of it happens without a word.
A little thanks keeps volunteers coming back.
Thank them during the season or at the end. Both can work.
How do you thank parents? Share your habit in the comments.
